PRACTICAL BUYING DETAILS

Before you choose a lot.

Match the product, specification and commercial terms.

Product questions

What evidence helps assess a saffron offer?

Declare dried-thread form, origin and grade, with agreed authenticity evidence and laboratory results for required colour, aroma, flavour and moisture parameters. Provide traceable lot and packing details.

For your supplier offer

  • Product form, grade and intended use
  • Origin, crop year and lot or sample reference
  • Target quality values and required test methods
  • Net quantity, bag or container size and liner preference
  • Destination or origin port and shipment period
  • Required documents and any sample request

Packing, storage & shelf life

Tell us the packing format and net weight you require. Bag construction, liner, labelling and pallet requirements are agreed with the offer. Confirm the lot’s storage conditions, shelf life or relevant dates rather than assuming a standard duration.

For food ingredients, agree the intended use, required testing and offered lot’s handling instructions.
